# Setup
```{r}
#| label: packages
library(tidyverse)
library(ssdtools)
library(ggplot2)

```

```{r}
#import
tox_dat <- read.csv(file = "Data/ToxSummary.csv")


#tidy
tox_dat_tidy <- tox_dat %>%
  #convert loec to noec by dividing by 2 if there is no noec, otherwise use noec
  mutate(noec_ssd = case_when(
    !is.na(noec_ug_l) ~ noec_ug_l,
    is.na(noec_ug_l) & !is.na(loec_ug_l) ~ loec_ug_l/2
  )) %>%
  #if acute exposure duration, divide the noec by 10, otherwise leave it along
  mutate(noec_ssd = if_else(chronic_acute == "acute", noec_ssd/10, noec_ssd)) %>%
  #include only higher level endpoints
  filter(endpoint %in% c("Growth", "Development", "Reproduction", "Mortality", "Growth + Development")) %>%
  #mark invasive species
  mutate(Species = if_else(note == "Invasive", paste0(Species, "*"), Species))

```

```{r}
#kitchen sink
fit_dat <- tox_dat_tidy %>%
    filter(!is.na(noec_ssd)) %>%
    group_by(Species) %>%
    mutate(Conc = median(noec_ssd)) %>% #collapse NOEC by species
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(Species, Conc, group) %>%
    summarise()    

ssd_fits <- ssd_fit_dists(fit_dat)

ssd_pred <- predict(ssd_fits, ci = TRUE)

ssd_plot(fit_dat, ssd_pred,
  label = "Species",
  color = "group",
  xlab = "Concentration (µg/L)",
  ribbon = TRUE,
  label_size = 4,
) +
  expand_limits(x = 3000) +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  labs(title = "All Species", color = "Taxonomic Group") +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 16))
```

# Acute Chronic Ratios

```{r}
geo_mean <- function(x) exp(mean(log(x[x > 0]), na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}

#Do we have acute and chronic data for each species?
species_sum <- tox_dat %>%
  group_by(Species, group) %>%
  summarise(
    acute   = if_else(any(chronic_acute == "acute"),   "Yes", "No"),
    chronic = if_else(any(chronic_acute == "chronic"), "Yes", "No"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(group, Species)

both_rows <- which(species_sum$acute == "Yes" & species_sum$chronic == "Yes")

species_sum %>%
  knitr::kable(col.names = c("Species", "Group", "Acute", "Chronic")) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling() %>%
  kableExtra::row_spec(both_rows, background = "#90EE90")

#Calculate the acute-chronic ratio for species where acute and chronic data are available
both_species <- species_sum$Species[both_rows]

acr_table <- tox_dat %>%
  filter(Species %in% both_species) %>%
  #just use noecs without applying assessment factors 
  filter(
    !(note == "NOEC from EC50"),
    !is.na(noec_ug_l)
  ) %>%
  #calculate the median chronic and acute NOECs
  group_by(Species, chronic_acute) %>%
  mutate(median_noec = median(noec_ug_l)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Species, group, chronic_acute, median_noec) %>%
  summarise(.groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = chronic_acute, values_from = median_noec) %>%
  mutate(acr = acute/chronic)

#take the geometric mean of all of the acute chronic ratios to get the Final Acute Chronic Ratio
FACR <- geo_mean(acr_table$acr)



```
